sources.name: Project-authored Lao capture text v1
sources.notes: Original project-authored Lao/mixed-language text committed under the repository Apache-2.0 license with a SHA-256 metadata record. Approved as the default source text for public printable capture campaigns. Real benchmark evidence still requires registered optical scans/photos of printed pages.

sources.name: HPLT v3 Lao (lao_Laoo)
sources.notes: Approved as bounded, provenance-recorded Lao training/model-development text input under the project policy. HPLT states that it licenses the dataset packaging under CC0 but does not own the underlying extracted text; downstream users remain responsible for applicable rights. Do not use sampled lines as public capture-pack source text or benchmark ground truth unless the underlying source is independently cleared.

sources.name: KhamLao MOE textbook-derived corpus/images
sources.notes: The repository is MIT, but its corpus pipeline states that it harvests Lao MOE textbooks. The repository license does not establish redistribution rights for the underlying textbook content. Do not ingest until those source rights are independently clarified.

sources.name: Lao-SABAIDEE
sources.notes: The dataset catalog lists about 500 Lao handwritten samples but no public download link and no clear redistribution license. Revisit only if an authoritative source and license become available.

sources.name: NayanaOCR Corpus 2025
sources.notes: Large synthetic multilingual OCR corpus, but its noncommercial terms do not match this project's permissive/commercial-friendly data policy. The published configs also do not provide a Lao-specific dataset path for our target.

sources.name: Lao Census CamScanner household-registration notice (2026-03)

evidence.parsed_text_observation: PDF extraction exposed only the source URL, not the Lao page text.
evidence.visual_observation: Rendered page is a raster Lao government scan with handwritten date/number marks, scan noise, and a CamScanner footer.

sources.notes: High-value real-world OCR stress candidate because the visible Lao text is raster-only while the PDF text layer is effectively absent. Keep remote-only until redistribution/evaluation rights are independently cleared.

sources.name: Lao Census digital ID-card home-delivery notice (2026)

evidence.parsed_text_observation: Parser returns Latin-like garbage rather than the visible Lao text.
evidence.visual_observation: Rendered page is a readable scanned Lao notice with handwritten document number/date and normal optical scan artifacts.

sources.notes: Useful bad-text-layer case: a PDF layer exists but is not a trustworthy transcription of the visible Lao page. Keep remote-only until rights are clarified.

sources.name: Lao Census registration/ID guidance scan (2026)

evidence.parsed_text_observation: PDF parser returned zero extracted text lines.
evidence.visual_observation: Rendered pages contain Lao body text and handwritten document-number/date marks with light raster/scan degradation.

sources.notes: Multi-page image-only Lao scan suitable as a remote OCR robustness candidate, but not approved for ingestion or redistribution.

sources.name: Lao Census stop-household-book notice scan (2026)

evidence.parsed_text_observation: PDF parser returned zero extracted text lines.
evidence.visual_observation: Rendered page contains Lao text, handwritten annotations, signature/stamp, uneven raster quality, and scan noise.

sources.notes: Strong single-page scan-quality stress candidate with handwriting/stamp overlays. Rights remain unclear, so keep remote-only.

sources.name: Lao Census police household-book notice scan (2026)

evidence.parsed_text_observation: PDF parser returned zero extracted text lines.
evidence.visual_observation: Rendered page is a scanned Lao government notice with handwritten date/number and optical noise.

sources.notes: Image-only multi-page government scan candidate. Do not ingest into public benchmark/training data without rights clearance.

sources.name: PTC CamScanner Lao notice (2024-02-15)

evidence.parsed_text_observation: Extracted PDF text is effectively only the repeated word CamScanner.
evidence.visual_observation: Rendered page contains full Lao text, handwritten date marks, scan specks/noise, low-resolution emblem, and CamScanner footer.

sources.notes: Excellent real-world image-only OCR candidate because visible Lao content is not represented by the useful text layer. Keep remote-only pending rights review.

sources.name: HPC CamScanner legislation PDF (2024-09-02)

evidence.parsed_text_observation: PDF parser returned zero extracted text lines across the 21-page document.
evidence.visual_observation: Rendered pages show raster Lao legislation, official seals/signatures, scan noise, and a CamScanner footer.

sources.notes: High-value long-form image-only Lao OCR stress candidate. Keep remote-only pending explicit redistribution/evaluation rights review.

sources.name: Lao National Assembly CamScanner invitation image (2023-11-24)

evidence.parsed_text_observation: The authoritative page publishes the document as an image rather than a selectable-text document.
evidence.visual_observation: The embedded source is explicitly labeled CamScanner 24-11-2023 14.22.

sources.notes: Direct image-input OCR candidate rather than a PDF-layer case. The authoritative page identifies the embedded document as a CamScanner image. Keep remote-only pending rights review.

sources.name: MAF/forestry CamScanner document 79-BLKS-343-DPS-2022

evidence.parsed_text_observation: Direct PDF open exposed zero native text lines.
evidence.visual_observation: Rendered first page is a raster Lao government document with handwritten date/number, scan specks, degraded emblem, uneven contrast, and a CamScanner footer.

sources.notes: Strong long-form camera/scanner OCR stress candidate. Search indexing can surface OCR-derived text, but the PDF itself exposes no native text layer. Keep remote-only pending rights review.

sources.name: MPWT Council of Lao Architects and Engineers CamScanner document

evidence.parsed_text_observation: Direct PDF open exposed only the word CamScanner.
evidence.visual_observation: The authoritative MPWT legislation listing identifies the file as a Council of Lao Architects and Engineers document and the PDF content layer is scanner-watermark-only.

sources.notes: Single-page official MPWT CamScanner candidate with no useful native document text. Keep remote-only pending rights review.

sources.name: MAF/forestry CamScanner document 30-MAF-BK-225

evidence.parsed_text_observation: Search indexing identifies the source as CamScanner 08-22-2022 13.28, but direct PDF inspection was blocked by the host verification page.
evidence.visual_observation: Not independently inspected; do not promote to verified candidate without a successful direct PDF/page review.

sources.notes: Likely high-value CamScanner Lao document, but intentionally kept unverified because the authoritative host blocks direct inspection. No ingestion or redistribution.

sources.name: Lao Official Gazette authoritative image-form PDF collection

evidence.parsed_text_observation: The official Gazette states that authoritative legislation is provided in image-form PDF, while searchable text/Word representations are informational.
evidence.visual_observation: Collection-level discovery source only; individual PDFs still require page/text-layer verification before being promoted to a verified candidate.

sources.notes: High-yield discovery source for official image-form Lao legal documents with weak/absent native text layers. This collection is not asserted to be camera-captured; use it to discover individual scan candidates and review each separately.

sources.name: NAP Laos Paris Agreement CamScanner PDF

evidence.parsed_text_observation: The PDF exposes an OCR layer, but Lao text contains visibly broken spacing/combining-mark segmentation and scanner-derived artifacts rather than a clean native document layer.
evidence.visual_observation: Rendered pages are raster scans and page 2 visibly carries a Scanned by CamScanner footer.

sources.notes: Useful camera-scan case where a text layer exists but should not be assumed trustworthy. NAP Laos is operated through the Lao environment/climate adaptation program; keep the document remote-only pending explicit rights review.

sources.name: LaoWIS Salavan groundwater management plan 2023 scan

evidence.parsed_text_observation: The PDF exposes OCR text, but table/page extraction is heavily fragmented into syllable-sized lines and loses the original table layout/order.
evidence.visual_observation: Indexed rendered content includes a rotated Lao table page stamped Scanned with CamScanner; the document therefore provides a useful rotation/layout-plus-OCR-layer stress case.

sources.notes: Mixed scan/OCR-layer candidate from the LaoWIS water-information repository. Especially useful for detecting unreliable pre-existing OCR/layout layers. Keep remote-only pending rights review.
